name: streak-card
title: Streak Card
description: A streak card: the day count pops into a disc as confetti bursts around it, and the week's marks tick in.

perf.budget: The confetti is one Skia canvas driven by a single UI-thread timing; it settles after about a second and nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The number, confetti and day marks appear in place without the burst or the pulse.
a11y.screenReader: The count reads as one label ("2 day streak"), the title as a header and the week as one line ("This week: We done, Th today, Fr upcoming").
a11y.touchTarget: The button is 52 pt tall and full width.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { StreakCard } from '@/components/kinetik/streak-card';

<StreakCard
  count={streak.days}
  days={[
    { label: 'Mo', state: 'done' },
    { label: 'Tu', state: 'missed' },
    { label: 'We', state: 'done' },
    { label: 'Th', state: 'today' },
    { label: 'Fr', state: 'upcoming' },
  ]}
  onContinue={close}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Celebrating a habit kept, right after the user finishes the day's task.

## When not to use

- Every app open: the burst is a reward and loses meaning if it plays all the time.
- Long histories: show a calendar instead of a week row.

## Notes

- The confetti and the number replay whenever `count` changes, with a success haptic after the first render.
- The week row centres on the day marked `today` and fades out at the sides, so pass a few days either side.
- `accent` colours today's mark and a few confetti pieces; the rest of the confetti stays quiet grey.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add streak-card`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
